content:
emma: Quick proposal: require creating a preview artifact (preview=true) for non-admin canaries by default. Return a lightweight preview_id from API and emit structured telemetry so console can show preview vs live diffs. Thoughts?

kai: +1 for safety. Suggest warn->enforce migration window. Also add X-Config-Apply-Id header for idempotency to prevent double applies.

mohit: Agree on idempotency. Implementation note: if enforcement is on and preview=false for non-admin, return 409 with header X-Config-Preview-Help pointing to console preview URL. Don't hard-block in warn mode.

daria: Console UX: show compact diff, provenance, and a small badge for warn/enforce mode. Add a cohort slider and a single CTA. Telemetry: preview_shown, preview_confirmed, apply_attempt, apply_result. Include preview_id and preview_digest.

emma: preview_digest = sha256(canonical_diff). Server persists minimal diff + metadata for 14 days by default; keep full blobs only on demand or for >=1% cohorts. That balances auditability vs cost.

kai: For dashboards: heatmap cohort_pct vs error_rate, and a "preview->apply delta" timeseries. Also metric config.apply.blocked_preview to track friction.

mohit: Trace sampling: sample 0.1% of requests for previewed cohorts and attach preview_id + preview_digest in internal trace metadata (not public headers). Console can link traces.

emma: OK action items: kai -> API PR (X-Config-Apply-Id, preview param, soft-enforce flag). mohit -> store + digest + retention. daria -> dashboard mocks + telemetry schema. I'll draft tiny RFC and ops policy for warn->enforce.

ops-bot: OpsBot: reminder — previews with cohort_pct >=1% are retained 14d automatically; manual retention up to 90d.

daria: I'll prototype the heatmap query and a compact diff renderer by EOD.

emma: If no objections by EOD I'll open RFC and tickets. :thumbsup:
